grievances.title: Water supply has been unavailable in my locality for the last five days
grievances.description: Drinking water supply to Pocket 4, Mayur Vihar Phase 1 has completely stopped since October 8. Over 150 families are affected and relying on expensive private water tankers. Despite multiple verbal complaints to the local junior engineer, no supply has resumed.

grievances.title: Overflowing municipal garbage vat blocking primary school entrance
grievances.description: The solid waste collection vat opposite Sarvodaya Kanya Vidyalaya has not been cleared for 9 days. Rotten garbage is spilling across the street, attracting flies, mosquitoes, and stray cattle. Foul smell is suffocating nearby residents and students.

grievances.title: Dark stretch on SG Highway service road due to dead street lights
grievances.description: All 14 LED street poles between Thaltej Cross Roads and Pakwan Dining Hall have been completely dead for 2 weeks. Pedestrians feel unsafe at night and two two-wheeler skidding accidents have occurred in this blind zone.
grievances.resolution_summary: Field technician inspected underground feeder cable; burnt fuse at distribution pillar box #4 was replaced. All 14 luminaires tested and confirmed operational.

grievances.title: Massive crater pothole on Aurobindo Marg near Adchini
grievances.description: A 2-foot deep, 4-foot wide trench pothole has formed in the middle lane of Aurobindo Marg northbound. Several cars have suffered rim damage and buses are violently swerving into oncoming traffic.

grievances.title: Drinking water pipeline burst causing road cave-in and drinking water wastage
grievances.description: Underground 300mm cast iron main water line burst near Drive-In Road junction. Thousands of liters of treated clean water are surging out onto the road every hour while nearby apartment blocks have zero water pressure.

grievances.title: Broken paving blocks and exposed rebar on pedestrian walkway near Metro gate
grievances.description: Pedestrian footpath tiles outside Botanical Garden Metro Gate #2 are shattered and steel rebar is jutting out. Senior citizens and children have tripped and suffered injuries.

grievances.title: Sewage backflow in residential storm gutter during light rains
grievances.description: Manholes at Lane 3, Satellite are choked with plastic bags and silt. Foul black water is bubbling onto the street and entering domestic car parking zones.

grievances.title: Severe mosquito surge around vacant civic plot near Rohini Sector 16
grievances.description: Stagnant stormwater on the unbuilt municipal school plot has become a massive breeding pool. Six dengue cases have been verified in our housing society in the last 10 days. Urgent insecticide fogging requested.

grievances.title: Distribution transformer emitting loud humming and intermittent sparks during peak load
grievances.description: Pole transformer outside Navrangpura commercial complex sparks violently whenever commercial ACs turn on between 1 PM and 4 PM. High fire hazard for adjacent trees and two-wheelers.
grievances.resolution_summary: Overloaded 100kVA transformer replaced with a 250kVA unit. Tree branches trimmed away from high-tension transmission cables by municipal horticulture division.

grievances.title: Dispute over private boundary wall constructed across public storm drain
grievances.description: Complaint regarding boundary dispute between private plot #12 and #13 on civic road alignment.
grievances.rejection_reason: Matter is currently sub-judice before the District Civil Court under Case No. CC/2025/4491. Under SPGS Rule 4(c), grievances involving pending civil litigation cannot be entertained in this civic forum. Citizen is advised to pursue through judicial proceedings.

grievances.title: Sewage contamination in municipal pipeline causing yellow foul water in Bopal
grievances.description: Water coming from municipal taps in Orchid Whitefield society has turned brownish-yellow with a pungent sewage stench. Residents report skin rashes and stomach infections.

grievances.title: Construction debris dumped overnight on green belt buffer near DDA Park
grievances.description: Three truckloads of demolition rubble and plaster debris have been dumped directly on the tree plantation strip along Outer Ring Road.
grievances.resolution_summary: Enforcement flying squad dispatched JCB excavators. 18 metric tons of C&D debris removed and delivered to Burari Recycling Facility. CCTV footage shared with Delhi Police to penalize vehicle owners.

grievances.title: Deep depression in asphalt after water pipeline laying in Vastrapur
grievances.description: Road excavated for underground cable laying was backfilled with loose sand without bitumen compaction. It has sunk 8 inches creating a severe trap for cyclists.

grievances.title: Commercial banquet hall operating high-decibel DJ amplifiers beyond midnight
grievances.description: Banquet facility on GT Karnal Road repeatedly blasts open-air bass music past 1 AM on weekdays, disrupting board exam students and elderly cardiac patients.
grievances.resolution_summary: Beat patrol sub-inspector visited premises, issued show-cause notice under DP Act Section 36(f). Sound limiter device calibrated and acoustic enclosure mandated.

grievances.title: Damaged drinking water filtration system at Municipal Primary School #8
grievances.description: RO water purifier installed in the primary school courtyard is leaking and filters have not been replaced for over a year. Students are drinking untreated borewell water.

grievances.title: Extremely weak water pressure reaching upper floors in Lajpat Nagar
grievances.description: Water does not rise above ground floor tanks during morning municipal hours. Booster pumps are pulling air. Entire 3rd and 4th floors of block K are dry.
